settings.aboutParagraph1: Every anime figure, heavyweight hoodie, and Chinese import arriving at our Kenitra studio is unpacked, inspected for sculpt and finish quality, and safely cushioned before courier dispatch.
settings.aboutParagraph2: Looking for a specific figure, desk setup piece, or bulk China import not listed in the current drop? Message us on Instagram with a reference photo and we will quote it in MAD.

products.name: Shadow Ronin Scale Figure
products.shortDesc: 24 cm dynamic katana pose with matte cloak sculpting and collector box.
products.description: High-detail PVC and ABS scale collectible featuring layered armor plating, metallic blade finish, and an interlocking display base. Inspected in Kenitra before shipment to guarantee clean paintwork and intact packaging.

products.name: Embossed Dragon Gongfu Tea Set
products.shortDesc: Matte obsidian exterior with crimson glaze interior and solid bamboo tray.
products.description: Imported directly from Fujian ceramic workshops. Includes one lidded gaiwan, sharing pitcher, tea canister, six tasting cups with embossed dragon relief, and a slotted drainage bamboo tray.

products.name: Kuro Heavyweight Kanji Hoodie
products.shortDesc: Dropped-shoulder charcoal fleece with raised crimson chest embroidery.
products.description: Cut in an authentic Japanese streetwear boxy silhouette from 420 GSM French terry cotton. Features vintage mineral wash, double-lined hood, and crisp high-stitch crimson kanji embroidery that holds shape after washing.

products.name: Mini Display Katana & Sakura Lamp
products.shortDesc: 25 cm alloy miniature katana with wooden stand and warm USB-C LED lamp.
products.description: Built for anime desk setups and bookshelves. Pairs a blunt zinc-alloy matte black miniature katana on a walnut-stained cradle with a warm 3000K engraved acrylic Sakura & Fuji night lamp on solid oak.

products.name: Chi-Long Mecha & 65% Custom Keyboard
products.shortDesc: Articulated crimson-gold mecha frame paired with hot-swap PBT keycaps.
products.description: Flagship import from Shenzhen combining a pre-assembled articulated Chi-Long mecha display unit with an ivory-and-crimson 65% mechanical keyboard featuring dye-sublimated dragon legends and coiled aviator cable.

products.name: Collector Trio & Lacquer Katana Stand
products.shortDesc: Three curated 18–22 cm anime figures plus full-size wooden stand display.
products.description: Our signature room centerpiece curated in Kenitra. Combines three character figures from classic action and fantasy series alongside a matte-scabbard display blade on a sculpted hardwood cradle.
